sourceFile: 31. TIU L5S3-01 R Report test add more bonding Fr+VP improve NG function 2025.12.18_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft captures the bonding-change topic but outcome grouping and comparisons are not reliable enough for final evidence.
issues: Type 1 and Type 2 bonding changes are combined without preserving type as subgroup or separate condition.
Comparisons reuse one Normal row and ignore other Normal rows, so row-level pairing is ambiguous.
Judgement states improved but source decision says reduction is unstable and needs more testing.
Measurement outcome appears generated from table headers/columns, not a valid separate measurement result.
Decision/result evidence rows on instability are not cited in the review case.
correctionPlan: Reconstruct the result table rows with headers and all condition labels.
Pair Normal and changed rows by preserved keys such as test number/date/type.
Represent Type 1 and Type 2 as separate changed conditions or explicit subgroups.
Remove the spurious measurement outcome unless real measurement evidence exists.
Update judgement to improved but unstable, citing result and decision rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations exist but are insufficient for final use because key decision rows and valid paired evidence are missing.
